content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The posts are on a contract or outsource basis under the control of DM&HO Mahabubabad District on a purely temporary basis for a period of one year or till actual need ceases, whichever is earlier. Appointees will work under the overall administrative control of CH&FW and MD (NHM). The monthly remuneration for each post is specified in the vacancy details. A termination notice of 30 days can be given from either side. Performance will be evaluated periodically for extension or termination.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DMHO Mahabubabad Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the application form from the official website of Mahabubabad District at https://mahabubabad.telangana.gov.in/. Fill out the application form completely and attach all essential self-attested certificate copies along with one passport-size photograph pasted on the form. Prepare a Demand Draft (DD) for the prescribed fee drawn in favour of “The District Medical and Health Officer, Mahabubabad”. Submit the filled application form along with enclosures and DD in person or through registered post to the F-25, O/o DMHO, Mahabubabad, IDOC-Mahabubabad. Ensure the application reaches on or before 29 October 2026 by 05:00 PM.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: S.S.C / Date of Birth Certificate issued by the Competent Authority Intermediate or 10+2 examination certificate Qualifying Examination Pass Certificate Marks Memos of all years of the qualifying examination Registration Certificates of respective Councils (Medical, Nursing, Para Medical, Board of Indian Medicine) Bridge Course certificate for MLHP Staff Nurses (B.Sc-N graduated before 2020 & GNM Category) Latest Community Certificate / EWC Certificate / Ex-Servicemen / NCC / Physically Handicapped certificate issued by competent authority (SC candidates must provide the latest community certificate as per Act No.15 of 2025 dated 14.04.2025) Study certificates from 1st class to 10th class (or residence certificate from Tahsildar/MRO for private study) PH certificate for candidates claiming reservation under PH Quota Relevant certificates for Ex-Service Men Quota Valid driving license and vehicle documents for Senior Dots plus TB HIV Supervisor One photograph pasted on the application form

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies in DMHO Mahabubabad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 67 vacancies advertised under various NHM programmes.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit filled applications is 29 October 2026 up to 05:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted offline in person or through registered post to the office of DMHO Mahabubabad.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for OC candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for OC candidates is Rs. 500/-, payable via Demand Draft.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for BC, SC, and ST candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for BC, SC, and ST candidates is Rs. 300/-, payable via Demand Draft.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for these posts?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 18 years and the maximum age is 44 years as on 01/07/2026, with relaxations applicable for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q7. Are these posts permanent government jobs?
faq.answer: No, these positions are purely temporary on a contract or outsource basis for a period of one year or till actual need ceases.

faq.question: Q8. Where should the application form be sent?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent to room number F-25, O/o DMHO, Mahabubabad, IDOC-Mahabubabad.
